title: Scam Warning Signs
description: Learn the common tactics scammers use to steal your money.
content: Guaranteed returns: No genuine investment guarantees high returns.
Urgency: 'Act now' or 'Limited slots' is a pressure tactic.
Unsolicited messages: Random WhatsApp/Telegram tips are extremely risky.
Payment to personal accounts: Real firms never ask for money in someone's personal name or a personal wallet.
Screenshots of profits are easily faked — they are not proof.

title: How to Verify an Advisor
description: Step-by-step guide to checking SEBI registration.
content: Ask for their SEBI Registration Number (starts with INA or INH).
Never trust a screenshot of a certificate. They are easily forged.
Go to sebi.gov.in and search the intermediaries database yourself.
If the registration cannot be found, do not invest and do not share documents.

title: Safe Digital Payments
description: Understand OTP, UPI PIN, and how money actually moves.
content: An OTP is a one-time password for a transaction happening right now. Nobody legitimate ever needs it.
A UPI PIN authorises money LEAVING your account. Never enter it to 'receive' money.
Scammers pose as bank staff, delivery agents, or officials to rush you into sharing a PIN.
If a caller asks for an OTP or PIN, hang up. Call your bank using the number on its official website.

title: Know Your Investor Rights
description: What you are entitled to when dealing with registered entities.
content: Registered intermediaries must give you official documents and disclosures.
You can file a complaint against a SEBI-registered entity on scores.sebi.gov.in.
You have the right to ask for the advisor's registration number and verify it.
Unregistered advisors giving paid tips are acting outside the law — report them.

title: Preparing a Complaint
description: How to document an incident so it can be reported effectively.
content: Save the original messages, numbers, UPI IDs, and links — do not delete the chat.
Note dates, times, and the amounts involved.
Do not share your own banking passwords while collecting evidence.
Report online fraud within the golden hour at cybercrime.gov.in or call 1930.

title: Nomination Awareness
description: Why nominations matter for your family's safety.
content: A nomination ensures your investments reach the right person without lengthy legal processes.
Keep nominee details updated after major life events.
Discuss nominations with family so they know what exists and where records are.

title: Spotting Financial Misinformation
description: How to judge viral investment claims and forward messages.
content: Forwarded messages are not evidence. Ask: who benefits if I believe this?
Check whether the claim appears on the official website of the regulator or company.
Be extra sceptical of claims about 'government schemes' with deadlines.
Use the Pause. Verify. Protect. habit: pause before acting, verify on official sources, then decide.
